steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star (G2V) with surface temperature ~5,500°C and core temperature ~15 million°C | Key Fact: Energy is produced by nuclear fusion: hydrogen nuclei fuse to form helium via the proton-proton chain | Key Fact: The Sun's layers: core (energy production), radiative zone, convective zone, photosphere (visible surface), chromosphere, corona | Key Fact: Sunspots are cooler, darker regions on the photosphere caused by magnetic field concentrations

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on GCSE Astronomy Exam Tips — The Sun, and one past-paper question.
